newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks lower in thin early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks lower in thin early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were lower in early morning trading on Wednesday, as rising momentum seen earlier this week dissipated amid thin volume, brokers said.
Attention was focused on shares in theme park operator Oriental Land Co Ltd, which were listed on the stock exchange on Wednesday.
At 0020 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was down 157.52 points or 0.76 percent at 20,664.60. Its December futures fell 80 points to 20,710.
Brokers said the Nikkei average would be in a temporary adjustment phase after rebounding by more than 500 points over the last two trading days.
